description: This source file 'start-wrapper.cjs' is a script for managing the startup behavior of a development and CI environment for a web application. It detects whether the environment is a Continuous Integration (CI) environment and redirects to a static server to prevent long-running watchers from being killed, or proceeds to start the development server with specific memory settings. It handles environment variable normalization, platform differences, and provides override options.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is a CI environment by checking environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a shell command synchronously with specified arguments, inheriting stdio and environment variables.
